title: Savings Calculator
description: Project your savings account balance based on your deposit, monthly contributions, and interest rate.

formula.summary: Each month, the balance grows by the monthly-equivalent interest rate and then the new contribution is added, compounding forward for the full savings period.

variables.meaning: Annual percentage yield (APY), as a decimal

faqs.question: Is this the same as a high-yield savings account?
faqs.answer: Yes - enter the APY your bank advertises and this models the same monthly-compounding growth most high-yield savings accounts use.

faqs.question: What if I don't add anything monthly?
faqs.answer: Set the monthly contribution to 0 to see how your initial deposit alone would grow at the given interest rate.

seoContent.heading: Building an emergency fund or short-term goal
seoContent.body: Savings accounts prioritize safety and liquidity over growth, so the interest rate is typically much lower than long-term investment returns. This calculator helps you see exactly how a given monthly contribution and rate combine to reach a target balance, which is useful for planning an emergency fund, a home down payment, or a vacation fund with a specific deadline.

seoContent.heading: Why consistency matters more than timing
seoContent.body: Because interest compounds monthly, consistently contributing the same amount every month - regardless of market conditions, since savings rates barely move day to day - produces a predictable, steadily growing balance that's easy to plan around.
